**Alphabet had the higher operating margin in fiscal 2023, by about 21.7 percentage points.**

| Company (fiscal 2023) | Revenue | Operating income | Operating margin |
|---|---|---|---|
| Alphabet (year ended Dec 31, 2023) | $307,394M | $84,293M | 27.42% |
| Disney (year ended Sep 30, 2023) | $88,898M | ≈ $5,100M | 5.74% |

Disney does not report an operating income line, so I derived it from its income statement. I took revenue minus costs and expenses ($79,906M) minus restructuring and impairment charges ($3,892M). Other income, interest and equity income are excluded.

The figure would change on a different basis. Disney's segment operating income was $12,863M, which would give a margin of about 14.5% and narrow the gap to roughly 13 points.

The difference is 27.42% − 5.74% = **21.69 percentage points**.
